Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_rec_no VARCHAR2(3);
 temp_inter_code VARCHAR2(5);
begin
 begin
 select inter_code, inter_desc,
 decode(inter_type, 'N', 'NFT', 'H', 'HOLD')
 into :inter_code, :s_inter_desc, :s_inter_type
 from valid_interdictions_lab
 where inter_code = :inter_code and
 inter_type in ('N', 'H')
 and sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('1185');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 temp_rec_no := :system.trigger_record;
 temp_inter_code := :inter_code;
 go_record('1');
 loop
 if :system.trigger_record != temp_rec_no and
 :inter_code = temp_inter_code
 then
 go_record(temp_rec_no);
 show_error('0069');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 then
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :inter_code is null
 then
 clear_record;
 end if;
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 go_record('1');
 loop
 if :control_mode = 'DRIVE'
 then
 begin
 insert into unit_interdictions
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, inter_code,
 insert_dats, source_test_id, inter_user_id, program_id)
 select unit_id,coll_date,:GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :inter_code,sysdate,:control_mode,:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name
 from units
 where drive_id = :drive_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 not exists (select *
 from unit_interdictions a
 where a.unit_id = units.unit_id
 and a.coll_date = units.coll_date
 and a.inter_code = :inter_code
 and units.chapter_id = a.chapter_id);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 elsif :control_mode = 'BATCH'
 then
 begin
 insert into unit_interdictions
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, inter_code,
 insert_dats, source_test_id, inter_user_id,program_id)
 select unit_id,coll_date,:GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :inter_code,sysdate,:control_mode,:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name
 from units
 where batch_id = :batch_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and not exists (select *
 from unit_interdictions a
 where a.unit_id = units.unit_id
 and a.coll_date = units.coll_date
 and a.inter_code = :inter_code
 and units.chapter_id = a.chapter_id);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('not inserting into table');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 elsif :control_mode = 'LOT'
 then
 begin
 insert into unit_interdictions
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, inter_code,
 insert_dats, source_test_id, inter_user_id,program_id)
 select unit_id,coll_date,:GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :inter_code,sysdate,:control_mode,:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name
 from units
 where lot_number = :lot_number
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and not exists (select *
 from unit_interdictions a
 where a.unit_id = units.unit_id
 and a.coll_date = units.coll_date
 and a.inter_code = :inter_code
 and units.chapter_id = a.chapter_id);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 elsif :control_mode = 'TBID'
 then
 begin
 insert into unit_interdictions
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, inter_code,
 insert_dats, source_test_id, inter_user_id,program_id)
 select unit_id,coll_date,:GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :inter_code,sysdate,:control_mode,:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name
 from units
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and 
 unit_id in (select distinct unit_id from utrs where tb_id=:ctrl_blk_6.tb_id
 union select distinct unit_id from utrs where tb_id=:ctrl_blk_6.tb_id
 union select distinct unit_id from utrs where tb_id=:ctrl_blk_6.tb_id) 
 and not exists (select *
 from unit_interdictions a
 where a.unit_id = units.unit_id
 and a.coll_date = units.coll_date
 and a.inter_code = :inter_code
 and units.chapter_id = a.chapter_id);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 elsif :control_mode = 'ITBID'
 then
 --message('placiong the interdiction');
 Declare
 nCount number:=0;
 pl_coll_date date;
 cursor units_cur is select distinct unit_id, coll_date from holding_tests where tb_id=:INT_TB_ID;
 begin
 For Z in units_cur loop
 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nCOunt from unit_interdictions where
 unit_id=Z.unit_id and inter_code=:interdictions.inter_code;
 
 If nCount = 0 then 
 
 If Z.coll_date is null then
 begin 
 select coll_date into pl_coll_date from units where unit_id=Z.unit_id
 and rownum=1;
 exception when others then 
 pl_coll_date:=null;
 End;
 Else
 pl_coll_date:=Z.coll_date; 
 End If; 
 
 insert into unit_interdictions
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, inter_code,
 insert_dats, source_test_id, inter_user_id,program_id)
 values (Z.unit_id, pl_coll_date,:GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :interdictions.inter_code, sysdate,:control_mode,
 :banner.user_id, :banner.prog_name);
 
 End if; 
 
 End Loop;
 
 
 
 /*select unit_id,coll_date,:GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :inter_code,sysdate,:control_mode,:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name
 from holding_tests
 where nvl(chapter_id ,:GLOBAL.chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and tb_id=:INT_TB_ID 
 and not exists (select *
 from unit_interdictions a
 where a.unit_id = holding_tests.unit_id
 and a.inter_code = :inter_code);
 */
 
 -- message('placed.....');
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 elsif :control_mode = 'COLL DATE'
 then
 begin
 insert into unit_interdictions
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, inter_code,
 insert_dats, source_test_id, inter_user_id,program_id)
 select unit_id,coll_date,:GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :inter_code,sysdate,:control_mode,:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name
 from units
 where trunc(coll_date) = :collect_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and not exists (select *
 from unit_interdictions a
 where a.unit_id = units.unit_id
 and a.coll_date = units.coll_date
 and a.inter_code = :inter_code
 and units.chapter_id = a.chapter_id);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 then
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_success
 then
 show_error('8010');
 else
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: POP_UNIT_INFO_INST
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE pop_unit_info_inst (pl_tb_id in varchar2) IS
 cursor unit_cur is select distinct unit_id, coll_date from holding_tests where tb_id =pl_tb_id;
 pl_coll_date date; 
BEGIN
 go_block('UNITS_INFO_INST');
 clear_block;
 FOR Z in unit_cur loop
 
 If Z.coll_date is null then
 begin 
 select coll_date into pl_coll_date from units where unit_id=Z.unit_id
 and rownum=1;
 exception when others then 
 pl_coll_date:=null;
 End;
 Else
 pl_coll_date:=Z.coll_date; 
 End If; 
 
 
 :UNITS_INFO_INST.UNIT_ID:=Z.unit_id;
 :UNITS_INFO_INST.coll_date:=pl_coll_date;
 :units_info_inst.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(Z.unit_id,null,null);
 next_record;
 END LOOP;
 first_record;
 set_block_property('UNITS_INFO_INST',update_allowed,property_false);
 set_block_property('UNITS_INFO_INST',insert_allowed,property_false);
 
END;

RecordGroup.Name: INTERDICTIO_INTER_CODE_LOV4
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select inter_code, inter_desc, decode(inter_type, 'N', 'NFT', 'H', 'HOLD') from valid_interdictions_lab where inter_type in ('N', 'H') and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) order by inter_type, inter_code

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_5_LOT_NUMBER_LOV3
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select distinct lot_number from units where lot_number is not null and trunc(insert_dats) between trunc(sysdate)-21 and trunc(sysdate) and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id order by lot_number desc

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_4_COLLECT_DAT_LOV2
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select distinct coll_date, to_char(coll_date,'DD-MON-YYYY') c_date from units where coll_date is not null and coll_date between trunc(sysdate)-21 and sysdate and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id order by coll_date desc

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_3_BATCH_ID_LOV1
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select distinct b.batch_id from batch_inputs b where 0 < (select count(*) from units u where b.batch_id = u.batch_id and b.chapter_id = u.chapter_id) and trunc(insert_dats) between trunc(sysdate)-21 and trunc(sysdate) and b.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id order by b.batch_id desc

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_2_DRIVE_ID_LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select distinct d.drive_id from drives_lab d where 0 < (select count(*) from units u where d.drive_id = u.drive_id and d.chapter_id = u.chapter_id) and d.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id order by drive_id desc
